items.signal_prefix: Deck strategy: EUV mask blanks have advanced into

set.signal: Deck strategy: EUV mask blanks have advanced into the mass-production (HVM) preparation phase; the company has a strategic cooperation with a leading global semiconductor manufacturer (not named) and product qualification is under way toward HVM readiness, after which full-scale mass production and supply capabilities will be expanded; it has internalised core EUV mask-blank technology and supplied samples for evaluation, and completed the Yongin EUV Center (Oct. 2025), which the deck places near its key customer and the Yongin semiconductor cluster.
